title: 30天回本：奶茶店老板娘用AI翻盘
summary: 连亏三个月的奶茶店老板娘，被闺蜜点醒用AI做短视频引流，不出镜不剪辑，一个月回本爆单。

shots.dialogue: 再亏下去，这店真要关了。
shots.positive_prompt: Vertical 9:16 realistic smartphone-shot footage, cold quiet bubble tea shop in the afternoon, a tired Chinese woman in her early 30s in an apron sits behind the cashier counter, slowly flipping a paper account ledger, deep sigh, shoulders slumped, several unsold cups of milk tea with condensation on the counter and empty chairs in the foreground. Medium close-up on the woman, subject sharp and in focus, background softly blurred with shallow depth of field. Dim grey-blue ambient light from the storefront window, low saturation, slight overhead fluorescent coolness, melancholic mood. Subtle natural motion: pages turning, chest rising with the sigh, faint steam. Handheld slight micro shake, no on-screen subtitle text baked into the frame, natural lip movement.
shots.negative_prompt: text overlay, subtitles, watermark, logo, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, over-smoothed plastic skin, cartoon, anime, 3D render, bright cheerful lighting, crowded store, morphing facial features, unnatural mouth, duplicate people
shots.image_prompt: 中文画面描述：竖屏9:16中近景，一位30岁左右穿围裙的中国女性坐在奶茶店收银台后，手翻账本、眉头紧锁轻声叹气，肩背略塌；前景收银台上摆着几杯挂着水珠、没卖完的奶茶，店内空荡无顾客；主体清晰、背景虚化，冷灰蓝窗光+冷白顶灯，低饱和压抑色调。

shots.camera: 固定机位手持微晃，中近景，缓慢微推近

shots.dialogue: 别急，现在实体店都用AI做短视频引流。
shots.positive_prompt: Vertical 9:16 realistic footage, a lively Chinese woman in her early 30s in casual jacket pushes open the glass door of a quiet bubble tea shop and walks straight in, takes the phone from her friend's hand, taps the screen, and a mobile AI short-video tool interface lights up. Fast screen inserts: AI writing a script, auto-editing timeline, generating a finished vertical video. Over-the-shoulder framing from behind the shop owner, subject sharp and background blurred, warm afternoon light spilling through the door creating a soft warm contrast against the previously cold interior. Quick energetic pace, natural hand gestures, natural lip movement, no baked-in subtitle text.

shots.dialogue: 不用出镜，不用会剪，AI帮你写、帮你剪、帮你发。第一周有人来，第二周开始排队。
shots.positive_prompt: Vertical 9:16 fast montage, energetic quick cuts: (1) AI tool interface generating a short vertical video and hitting publish, (2) phone screen view counts climbing rapidly, (3) customers walking into the bubble tea shop, (4) delivery order tickets piling up, (5) the female shop owner busy behind the counter laughing while making drinks. Same Chinese woman around 30 in an apron, subject always sharp and in focus, background softly blurred, motion blur for speed. Lighting warms up progressively from cool grey-blue to bright warm golden, high saturation, uplifting rhythm, natural lip movement, no baked-in subtitle text.

shots.dialogue: 一个月，真的回本了！实体店不会做短视频的，评论区扣1，我把方法发你。
shots.positive_prompt: Vertical 9:16 realistic footage, the Chinese woman owner around 30 in an apron sits at the counter counting cash with a satisfied confident smile, she and her friend clink two cups of bubble tea together, a sticky note reading '本' or a calendar-style '30天' note stuck on the counter edge. Medium shot, subject sharp and in focus, background softly blurred with warm shop lights and a few customers. Bright warm golden lighting, high saturation, hopeful uplifting mood, natural joyful lip movement, no baked-in subtitle text.
